QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] The Ominous Aura
QuestInfo.0: #bPerzen#k is urgently looking for you. Go to #bAltaire Camp#k and talk to him.
QuestInfo.1:
Perzen detected an ominous aura around the barrier and it needs to be investigated.
Go see #bDestonen#k, who is exploring #bBoulder Mountain Entrance#k west of the camp.
QuestInfo.2: You met Destonen, who was exploring west of the camp, to investigate the #rominous aura#k detected recently near the Barrier Stone after hearing about it from Perzen.
